versions.content: RptHook specifies the link to rapid prototyping algorithm The rptHook describes the link between the byPassPoint and the rapid prototyping algorithm. If the rapid prototyping algorithm is described as an AUTOSAR Software Component the rptArHook reference is applicable. Otherwise, the definition of a codeLabel and optionally mcdIdentifier shall be used.
